title: Missing Addends Within 20 Worksheets
intro: Teach the blank as an unknown part of a total.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Model 8 + □ = 13 with counters. Keep eight visible and ask the student to find how many more are needed.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

Whole bracelet: 12 beads.

Beads already on the string: 8.

8 + ? = 12
12 − 8 = 4
8 + 4 = 12

Ask your student

What number would make both sides equal?

If your student needs help

If the student adds the two printed numbers, point to the total and ask which part is still missing.
